mapper.insert: INSERT INTO curriculum_import_job (id, filename, file_path, file_type, status, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{filename}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, filename, file_path, file_type, status, total_items, parsed_items, confidence, error_message, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM curriculum_import_job WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM curriculum_import_job WHERE deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE curriculum_import_job SET status = #{status}, total_items = #{totalItems}, parsed_items = #{parsedItems}, confidence = #{confidence}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO curriculum_import_item (id, job_id, course_code, course_name, semester, credits, hours, category, module, prerequisites_json, ability_tags_json, confidence, page_ref, status) VALUES (#{id}, #{jobId}, #{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{semester}, #{credits}, #{hours}, #{category}, #{module}, #{prerequisitesJson}, #{abilityTagsJson}, #{confidence}, #{pageRef}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_id, course_code, course_name, semester, credits, hours, category, module, prerequisites_json, ability_tags_json, confidence, page_ref, status, merged_into, created_at, updated_at FROM curriculum_import_item WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE curriculum_import_item SET course_code = #{courseCode}, course_name = #{courseName}, semester = #{semester}, credits = #{credits}, hours = #{hours}, category = #{category}, module = #{module}, prerequisites_json = #{prerequisitesJson}, ability_tags_json = #{abilityTagsJson}, status = #{status}, merged_into = #{mergedInto}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_id, course_code, course_name, semester, credits, hours, category, module, prerequisites_json, ability_tags_json, confidence, page_ref, status, merged_into, created_at, updated_at FROM curriculum_import_item WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO curriculum_version (id, name, major, course_count, status, source_job_id, published_at, published_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{major}, #{courseCount}, #{status}, #{sourceJobId}, #{publishedAt}, #{publishedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM curriculum_version WHERE deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (id, version_id, course_code, course_name, semester, credits, hours, category, module, prerequisites_json, source_item_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{versionId}, #{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{semester}, #{credits}, #{hours}, #{category}, #{module}, #{prerequisitesJson}, #{sourceItemId})
INSERT INTO course_ability_tag (id, course_id, ability_tag) VALUES (#{id}, #{courseId}, #{abilityTag})
